name: vrx
description: VRX — Social VR companion for VRChat + ChilloutVR
author: Imperix1155

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:credential-persistence-linux:
sh -c 'if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_ARGUMENTS >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! npm --silent run build:credential-persistence-probe >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_BUILD >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! ./node_modules/.bin/electron --password-store=gnome-libsecret out/credential-probe/index.js write "$1" >/dev/null; then if [ ! -f "$1/.vrx-credential-persistence-probe" ]; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_EXECUTION >&2; else printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_WRITE >&2; fi; exit 1; fi; if ! ./node_modules/.bin/electron --password-store=gnome-libsecret out/credential-probe/index.js read "$1" >/dev/null; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_READ >&2; exit 1; fi' --
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/assert-entry-chunk.mjs
scripts.guide:build: npm run guide:typecheck && vite build --config docs/guide/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:credential-persistence-local:
sh -c 'if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_ARGUMENTS >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! npm --silent run build:credential-persistence-probe >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_BUILD >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! env VRX_CREDENTIAL_PROBE_STORAGE=local ./node_modules/.bin/electron --password-store=basic out/credential-probe/index.js write "$1" >/dev/null; then if [ ! -f "$1/.vrx-credential-persistence-probe" ]; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_EXECUTION >&2; else printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_WRITE >&2; fi; exit 1; fi; if ! env VRX_CREDENTIAL_PROBE_STORAGE=local ./node_modules/.bin/electron --password-store=basic out/credential-probe/index.js read "$1" >/dev/null; then printf "%s
" ASSERT_PROBE_READ >&2; exit 1; fi' --
